description: Execution/SOR controls consumed by the Java BacktestEngine/PaperTrading (ConfigService.executionLimits/sorOptions) and the research cost model. ENFORCED (PLATFORM_CONVENTIONS.md section 11.3-11.4): defaults.max_participation (share of session volume a child may take), defaults.min_slice_interval_ns (per-instrument child spacing), defaults.latency_budget_ns (decision-to-arrival budget; a venue path slower than it blocks the child), defaults.max_child_qty (algo slices above it are split), sor.prefer_rebate and sor.max_venue_latency_ns (venues with a slower latency_mean_ns are ineligible; a stale/halted venue is never eligible). Violations block the order and are counted (BacktestEngine.Counters).

cost_model.description: Research-backtester cost model (iap.backtest.costs): cost = half_spread + fee + impact; impact_bps = impact_coeff_bps_per_pct_adv * (|child_qty| * qty_unit / adv * 100) with qty_unit = lot_size for FX and 1 for equities (base units, identical to the C++/Java simulator rule 6). Fees mirror configs/venues.json primary venues (XV1 equities taker, PRI FX).
